name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Fix chat_preview AJAX regression: the 3.0.8 action->afm_action rename updated every button but missed runChatPreviewAjax()'s manually-constructed FormData, which still hardcoded the old field name (formData.set('action', 'chat_preview')). Chat Preview has been silently broken since 3.0.8. Fixed, and added regression tests since this path had zero prior coverage.

Make the Step 2 'Current: ...' status and incompleteness warning update live as you interact with the form, instead of only refreshing on the next full page load. Switching programming type, picking a seed track or anchor, typing a CLAP/lyrics query, or choosing a mood/cluster now updates the status immediately client-side, mirroring the server's _programming_detail_from_values/_programming_incomplete logic.
